issues: Summary says the people gathered one day each week, but the supplied verses describe only that they gathered on one day of the week; recurrence is not explicit in verses 12–14.
Location Antionum is inferred from the prior context and not stated in the scene's cited verse 14.
Antionum is not identified as the location of Alma's prayer in verses 30–31; setting is unspecified.

The source identifies the speaker as Alma through the surrounding narration (Alma 31:36: “when Alma had said these words”), but the scene correctly avoids naming him because that identification is outside its cited verses.
The inference that fellow laborers may be shown near the speaker is not directly established as a specific visual arrangement; the verses say they are with him, without specifying their position.

The preceding verse says the people with Alma separated from one another, but this verse's 'they' refers to those people; their identity as Alma's companions is supported by the preceding context, not verse 37 alone.
